interpretation.label: merged_channel_hypothesis_not_supported

preconditions.name: control_arm_coverage_complete
preconditions.description: Every intended SEPARATED (control) cell produced a usable calibration_gap. The dv_headroom checks below are denominated on this same set, so a short control arm must refuse here rather than silently certify headroom over fewer cells than the criteria need.

preconditions.name: harm_head_action_sensitivity_present
preconditions.description: Worst-cell mean |harm_logit(z,a1)-harm_logit(z,a2)| over a fixed probe batch and two distinct movement actions, measured after P1 training. This is the SAME statistic the load-bearing criteria route on (a difference of two harm logits at one state under two actions), not a magnitude proxy on a different component -- 993 asserted the FORWARD head's sensitivity at 17.9x over floor while the readout the criteria actually read was flat. An action-blind harm head makes causal_sig structurally zero in BOTH arms, so below-floor means substrate-not-ready.
preconditions.control: 16-sample probe batch, actions 0 vs 1, worst cell across the 8 SEPARATED (control) cells of the full-grid set

preconditions.name: p1_harm_events_observed_per_condition
preconditions.description: MIN(total P1 harm events summed over arms+seeds) across the two hazard-density conditions -- 993 red-team fix F7: a pooled floor let SPARSE's harm head train on near-zero labeled data while DENSE's volume masked it. Taking the min across conditions requires BOTH to have real coverage.

preconditions.kind_note: floor_headroom = min(control calibration_gap) - 0.0 is exactly the room the MERGED arm has to FALL, which is what this suppression-direction criterion consumes. 0.0 is used as the floor because 'no hazard-conditional harm calibration at all' is the meaningful bottom; the logit difference is formally unbounded below, so this UNDERSTATES the available room and is therefore conservative. Design-time probe expectation: ~0.082 measured vs 0.06 required (~1.36x).
preconditions.name: dv_headroom_margin_room_below_control

preconditions.kind_note: The 2026-09-03 cluster autopsy's own table pairs 993's max |calibration_gap| (0.00152) against SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR (0.02) for a 13.1x shortfall, so max_abs is the sanctioned statistic for this non-degeneracy floor. Design-time probe expectation: ~0.215 measured vs 0.08 required (~2.68x).
preconditions.name: dv_headroom_control_signal_floor_reachable

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff C1_dense AND C2_sparse when BOTH conditions clear non-degeneracy; if only one condition clears it, outcome is that condition's criterion alone (label prefixed single_condition_only_partial_evidence); if neither clears it, unknown/non_degenerate=false. Each criterion additionally requires ALL 4 seeds to show MERGED<=SEPARATED (sign-consistency), not just a pooled mean margin. MARGIN=0.15 and SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR=0.2 are derived from the control arm's measured range (see the module docstring), and both are additionally gated at runtime by the dv_headroom preconditions H1/H2, which are evaluated over the SEPARATED cells BEFORE any MERGED cell is trained.

evidence_direction_note: Governance override, 2026-09-05. The driver's pre-registered combination rule emitted `weakens` for both ARC-021 and MECH-069 because both discrimination criteria failed on both clauses (mean <= -0.15 AND all 4 seeds <= 0), and both manifest copies plus the derived index already carry that. A cross-model Step 7c red-team on the ADJUDICATION returned CONTESTED and the Step 8 human gate ratified `mixed` instead. Reason: the effect-size bound originally written into the adjudication used a z-multiplier on n=4 paired diffs; the correct t(3) 95 percent intervals are [-0.204, +0.191] (DENSE) and [-0.158, +0.382] (SPARSE), so the run does NOT exclude the pre-registered -0.15 degradation in either condition, and joint power at -0.15 is about 12 percent -- a FAIL is the modal outcome even when the claim is exactly right. Two further limits reinforce it: only one of ARC-021's two falsifier DVs (calibration_gap, not attribution accuracy) was read, and the merge was performed on driver-local surrogate heads over a frozen z_world rather than the E1/E2/E3 stack the claim's precondition names by file. The run remains informative -- it rules out a large merged degradation (roughly 0.20+ DENSE / 0.16+ SPARSE) in a faithful topology analogue on a working readout -- but it is not a clean falsification, so `mixed` rather than `weakens`. Full reasoning: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-993a_2026-09-05.md sections 4, 5 and 13. Ratifying commit: governance-20260905 (this write).
